content: Apan, mɛ kàmɛn un'kyeey mwɛy an'yàtyà fà du. Nde kàkäär nsab a un'baan anà dwaaŋ a buur.
Nde kàkör dalàgɔ, ntäy itaan, awà ileŋ anà Satanà, waa kun'bäm dwaaŋ ntɔn mbul nsaab.
Un'kyeey kun'tɔɔm kà un'baan, kun'bäm a nsab, waa kàbɛɛrà inyɛm udu ande, ntɔn dalàgɔ ukɔ̈ɔ̈n afàbwiy in'sɛŋ ndwaŋ tii isàkwo mbul nsaab. Ungö apan bàkyer asun'tsuuŋ ntɔn kitaaŋ.

Ungö, mɛ kàmɛn an'kir a imwol. Baar bàbwaayà udu a ma bàwɛl ikɔ̈b mutsul nsaŋ. Mɛ kàmɛn sye mɔ̈ɔ̈ a baar abà batsül in'tswe ntɔn bàtää ba imbäl a Yɛsu anà kyà ndaa a Nzam. Ba bàkömà anki ntsür itàkal idiim awa anà ba bàwɛl anki inyɛm awa u ntabwey, itàkal u kɔɔ. Ba bàkyer awiyà anà bàyaal anà Klistɔ mbul nsaab.
Akü bumwɛy bàwiyà anki kusà a mbul nsaab mukwo. Ayi yà ngwiiyà yàtàtwɛb.
Baar ban'wal kab unsà ngwiiyà atàtwɛb ayi, bà aŋun'sak anà aŋin'kyɛɛl! Udu a ba ukwà bàyweel bàsàkal anki. Ba bàsàkal angaŋ a Nzam anà Klistɔ, anà ba bàsàyaal anà Klistɔ mbul nsaab.
Mpal isàkwo mbul nsaab, Satanà bàkyer asun'twey u bɔlokà ande,
anà nde asàkyà mukayikur in'sɛŋ amyà kà an'twɛrà a mɛɛn mà anà, ikaswaŋà naa Gɔg anà Magɔg. Nde asaköŋà ntɔn mumwaan ità: un'tal aba wà asànaa ansɛŋ a ngyäl.
Ba bàbilà a ngwal u mɛɛn manswà, waa bàdiŋà ikal a aŋin'kyɛɛl, iswaŋà naa bul a Nzam lànkween. Wɛɛ mbaa yàfü du, waa yadwä.
Apan, un'lwɛɛb aba ileŋ, akyà kyàkürà baar, bun'tɔɔm u yaaŋ a mbaa, ntsü abà ntsür anà aŋangɔɔm a loor. Ba bàsàman mpay mpib anà mwäänà u mbul a in'tye.
Apan, mɛ kàmɛn kir a imwol làkölàköl làpɛɛl anà mbuur kàbwaayà udu a la. Du anà mɛɛn màtiin ukwɛl kusà ande, anà ma bàfàsàman anki.

Ungö apan mɛ kàmɛn akü, andweer anà ambɛy, bàŋàmbar kusà a kir a imwol. In'kaan bàkyer aduub. Un'kaan asin bàkyer aduub, un'kaan a mɔ̈ɔ̈. Akü batsül nsaŋ, mbuur mbuur mulab nsyääl ande, asànaa bàsön ya uboo a in'kaan.
Ngyäl kàfuur akü ande, ukwà anà an'lɔŋ màfuur akü ama. Ba banswà batsül nsaŋ, mbuur mbuur asànaa byàkäl isal ande.
Ukwà anà an'lɔŋ batɔɔm u yaaŋ a mbaa. Yaaŋ a mbaa alà bà ukwà bàyweel.
Isàkal naa mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande bàsön anki uboo a un'kaan a mɔ̈ɔ̈, nde bun'tɔɔm u yaaŋ a mbaa.
